pending_pull_requests.title: fix(nfc): decode UTF-16 NDEF text records
pending_pull_requests.scope_note: Only nfc/src/ndef.rs changes. NDEF Text status bit selects UTF-8 or UTF-16; UTF-16 honors LE/BE BOM, defaults to BE without BOM, rejects odd byte counts, and decodes units lossily so a valid Bluetooth MAC survives text decoding. Two new pure parser tests cover three endian/BOM forms, non-BMP text and incomplete code units. No Bluetooth transport, ordinary Studio pairing, key input, motor or sensor implementation change.
